A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Guided Query Refinement (GQR). All 28 pages of each version, including Appendices A–G, support comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original GQR experiments on ViDoRe 1–3, including retrieval scores, latency measurements, hyperparameter sweeps, and design-choice analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 2.3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same candidate-pool construction, consensus distribution, KL objective, query-embedding optimization, and final ranking procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ViDoRe 1, 2, and 3 datasets and subsets for visual document retrieval. No task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same individual retrievers, Average Ranking, RRF, Min-Max and Softmax score aggregation, their tuned variants, and the MonoQwen2-VL reranker.

E3.justification: The reported model configurations, 10% development splits, retrieval K=10, tuning grids, NDCG@5 and Recall@5 metrics, and tuned versus zero-shot evaluation protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The hyperparameter sweep, latency breakdown, extra-search, candidate-pool, objective-function, role-swapping, and per-query analyses are retained. Redrawing Figures 4–5 does not add or revise an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report latency averaged over 100 runs and standard deviations across retriever pairs. Run information and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical tables and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains 63.1 NDCG@5 for Colnomic-7B with Jina (text), and Figure 5 retains total latencies of 192 ms and 241 ms despite its redraw.

T1.justification: The method's mathematical formulation and Equations 1–12, including Appendix C's aggregation and divergence definitions, are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about architecture-agnostic query refinement, guidance from weaker complementary retrievers, and improved retrieval efficiency and Pareto tradeoffs.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning embedding-space constraints, ViDoRe 1 saturation, learning-rate stability, and effects confined to the original candidate pool are unchanged. Appendix G's grammatical correction does not alter its explanation.

D1.justification: The code-access link and implementation disclosures remain unchanged, including Docling v2.34, page-level indexing, Adam, A100 measurements, model details, and selected hyperparameters in Tables 20–25.

R1.justification: The references and positioning relative to multimodal retrieval, hybrid fusion, and test-time query refinement are unchanged. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: Appendix G changes 'as function of the weight' to 'as a function of the weight.' The first-page arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 3–5 replace raster graphics with vector drawings, with heavier labels and lines, adjusted plot sizing and tick presentation, and small spacing shifts. Their captions and underlying findings remain unchanged; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: The vector redraws and more prominent labels in Figures 3–5 improve readability of the efficiency and sensitivity plots. Together with the grammatical correction, this provides a limited presentation benefit; scientific evidence, claims, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
